description: This file defines the ConnectParticipantClient class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Participant Service API, including method annotations for various service actions and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: ConnectParticipantClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Connect Participant Service, extending AwsClient, with method annotations for service API calls.

methods.name: cancelParticipantAuthentication
methods.description: Cancels participant authentication within a session.

methods.description: Describes a view within the service.

methods.description: Disconnects a participant from a session.

methods.description: Gets the URL for participant authentication.
